title: hemisphaerocarya suffruticosa var. typica
intro: Hemisphaerocarya suffruticosa var. typica, commonly known as Chinese water plantain or Manchurian water plantain, is a plant species in the family Menispermaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Hemisphaerocarya suffruticosa var. typica include its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which help reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
